title: "Figures"
---

Figure scripts read `<DATA_ROOT>/data/outputs/` and write to `50_plots/`. None fits a
model. Output file names carry the display item (`FIG-N`, `SUPPFIG-N`, `SUPPTABLE-N`,
`SUPPDATA-N`), and every figure script also writes the plotted values as a `_DATA.csv`.

## Figure 4 aggregation

Script 54 aggregates the SHAP values with `aggfunc = 'mean'` within each site grid, and
fits the curve to the cross-site median per bin. The `median` set for the two bin
coordinate columns applies to the bin edges only, where every record carries the same
value; it avoids floating-point noise in the labels and does not affect the SHAP values.

## Table 1 and Supplementary Fig. 4

Script 47 computes the eighteen tests and writes `47_THRESHOLD_Robustness_NEP_ZSCORE.csv`;
script 55 renders that file as the table and the figure, so the two cannot disagree.

| Group | Tests |
|---|---|
| Soil water depth | deepest usable layer at all sites; the 128 sites with a deeper layer at their shallowest and deepest; the 59 sites with five or more layers at their shallowest and deepest |
| Model fitting | TA dropped; blocked cross-validation; mean instead of median per bin; penalized spline instead of the polynomial; ALE instead of SHAP; 23 estimator settings |
| Site set | each site removed in turn; Europe, North America and both removed; records of at least 3, 5 and 10 years |

Each row gives the test, the number of sites, the threshold in σ and in kPa, and the
95 percent prediction band of the fit; every row converts to kPa with its own site set.
Three rows carry another interval and are marked with an asterisk: the estimator row the
range across its 23 settings, the leave-one-site-out row the range across the 208
removals, and the ALE row the confidence interval of the mean of the per-site crossings.
The bootstrap over sites that script 47 also writes (`boot_lower`, `boot_upper`) is
narrower than the prediction band in every test and is not shown.

`MAIN_ROWS` in script 55 selects the fifteen rows of Table 1, one per kind of test with
the depth rows as pairs; the figure shows all eighteen.

## Script 57 settings

| Setting | Default | Effect |
|---------|---------|--------|
| `PLOT_FEATURE` | `VPD_ZSCORE` | Predictor on the x axis |
| `FLUX` | `NEP_ZSCORE` | Target |
| `USE_MEDIAN` | `False` | Mean across sites; `True` for the median |
| `USE_CI` | `True` | 95 percent interval in the labels; `False` for the standard error |
| `VARIANT` | `""` | Run variant to read |
